title: Restore the reading position after browser Back
steps: Scroll down Morgan Reed's Replies stream to load additional replies, then pause at Route note 05 in Weekend walking plans 01.
Open the topic using the title link beside Route note 05.
Use browser Back and inspect the returned Replies stream.

video_guide.summary: Compare the visible replies around Route note 05 before opening its topic and after returning to Replies.

chapters.note: Morgan Reed’s public Replies stream shows Route notes 40, 39 and 38 under Weekend walking plans 05.
Route note 05 under Weekend walking plans 01 is visible between Route notes 06 and 04.

chapters.label: Open the topic title beside Route note 05

chapters.note: Weekend walking plans 01 is open with Route note 05 near the top.
